$comment: Backend registry. One entry per reachable backend; the gateway resolves /api/<key>/* against it.
Ported from web/*/sap_config.json in SAP-Project-Development V1, which duplicated this block
identically across 13 proxy.py processes. Adding a backend is an entry here, not new code.
odata - a dedicated SAP OData V4 service (ZFS_SB_*_O4_API). Typed, one per business object.
dyngw - the dynamic gateway service (ZFS_SB_DYNGW_O4_API): Registry + CallLog broker calls,
so a new app needs a registry row rather than an ABAP transport.
rest  - a non-SAP JSON/REST API. 'middleware' is the first instance; see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
for what the gateway does and does not do for one.
sqlite - a local SQLite file answered in-process (no 'base'; 'file' is relative to the repo
root). Schemaless JSON records in named collections, OData-shaped responses.
No secret belongs in this file. 'passwordEnv' names an environment variable; the gateway
refuses to start if a referenced variable is unset.

ottk.description: ZFS_SB_SLCOTTKDETAIL_O4_API — SlcOttkDetail, SlcOttkFee, Bank, EntityString, CoCode, RefInt, FeeType

dttk.description: ZFS_SB_SLCDTTKDETAIL_O4_API — SlcDttkDetail, SlcDttkFee, Bank, CFeeType, DFeeType

trmfx.description: ZFS_SB_TRMFX_O4_API — TrmFx (FTR FX deal CRUD + Settle over BAPI_FTR_FXT_*)

trmfxapp.description: ZFS_SB_TRMFXAPP_O4_API — TrmFxApp: the TSF append data of an FX deal (ZSGTSFTR_APP_STR: TxnStatus, Ztrcode, NDF FO/MO remarks, Deal ID). Managed CRUD, ETag on LocalLastChangedAt

trmmaster.description: ZFS_SB_TRMMASTER_O4_API — FTR customizing: ContractType, ProductCategory, ProductType, TransactionType, FlowType

trmfxapp.description: ZFS_SB_TRMFXAPP_O4_API — TrmFxApp (TSF fields missing from the FX views; key CompanyCode + FinancialTransaction)

slctsfbpbank.description: ZFS_SB_SLCTSFBPBANK_O4_API — SlcTsfBpBank (business partner bank details per company code)

businesspartner.description: API_BUSINESS_PARTNER (OData V2) — A_BusinessPartner; read here only for partner names

fx.description: ZFS_SB_TRMFX_O4_API — FxTransaction (create / read / reverse via the FTR BAPIs, Settle action)

middleware.description: SLC middleware — reads SAP tables directly. data/entityString serves ZSGTSFTR_ENT_STR.

dyngw.description: ZFS_SB_DYNGW_O4_API — Registry, CallLog. Brokered access; no per-object ABAP service.

local.description: Local SQLite store — persistence for apps with no SAP contract yet. /api/local/<collection>[/<id>]

examples.$comment: Not loaded. Copy into 'services' and fill in when a real non-SAP API exists.

billing.description: Shape only — the rest seam is built and tested, no instance is configured.
